owner_calls.question: For a world spanning several titles, the count stage sits on that world's first title (e.g. Iron Man (2010), Ultimate Spider-Man, Big Hero 6, Marvel Rising: Initiation, M.O.D.O.K.), but the recaps only mark the world terminated on its last title (Avengers Confidential, Avengers: Secret Wars (2017), Baymax!, Marvel Rising: Playing with Fire, Hit-Monkey). Should each stage move to the title whose recap marks the termination?
options: Move each stage to the title whose recap says 'marked terminated'
Keep stages on the world's first title
owner_calls.evidence: Stages 0-36 match the recaps' 'marked terminated' titles one to one; from stage 37 on, 8 stages sit on an earlier title of the same world than the recap that reveals the termination (both logs, identical).
